purpose.zh: 负重练大腿和臀部，提升下蹲能力
purpose.en: Build the thighs and glutes and improve your squat with added weight.

text.zh: 壶铃抱在胸前，臀部向后下坐
text.en: Hold the kettlebell at your chest and sit your hips down and back

text.zh: 膝盖对准脚尖，脚跟踩地
text.en: Keep your knees over your toes and your heels down.

text.zh: 胸口保持抬起，推地站起
text.en: Keep your chest up and push through your feet to stand.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back and letting the weight drift away.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.
